summary: Master diversity and inclusion strategies to build equitable workplaces and drive measurable cultural transformation. Enroll in our expert-led course.
lede: Diversity and inclusion training helps HR and people professionals assess workforce representation and improve people processes. It covers diversity audits, inclusion scorecards, competency-based interviews, inclusive onboarding, and policy reviews. Participants use these methods to identify gaps, shape practical action plans, and report inclusion progress to leaders.
audienceIntro: This training is built for professionals who need to improve workforce representation, design fairer people processes, and report inclusion progress with practical evidence.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include basic HR or people-management knowledge, familiarity with hiring or onboarding processes, and a working understanding of employee data and workplace policies. No coding is required. You should be prepared to review sample recruitment documents, policy excerpts, inclusion survey results, and a simple diversity dashboard during exercises.
